name: PoolPartyBof-V5
help: PoolParty variant 5 inject (TP_ALPC). Packs four ints always.
long_help: Inject-only. Arguments: pid delay drip drip_ms shellcodeFile. Does not sanity-check. Run poolparty-v5-sanity first if unsure.

arguments.name: delay
arguments.desc: Seconds between major API steps (0 = none). Always packed.

arguments.name: drip_ms
arguments.desc: Milliseconds between drip pages. Always packed.
